entries.description: Public read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and open research dataset providing anonymized 10-round agricultural simulation games from SOIL (crop rotations, soil quality, nutrition, weather events, and economic outcomes).
representativeQueries: Anonymisierte Forschungsdaten aus dem Landwirtschafts-Planspiel SOIL abfragen
Compare organic vs. conventional crop rotation yields and soil quality in SOIL simulation games
Query anonymized agricultural simulation research games via MCP
